description: This file is a JavaScript module defining utility functions and API interaction functions related to 'combos' in an e-commerce or grocery application. It includes functions for fetching combo data, computing totals and availability, and fallback to mock data if backend is unavailable.

methods.name: tryFetch(url, options = {})
methods.description: Utility function to perform a fetch with timeout and backend availability detection.

methods.name: computeTotals(combo)
methods.description: Computes pricing and availability details for a combo object, including original price, savings, and stock status.

methods.name: listCombos()
methods.description: Fetches list of combos from backend or mock data if backend is unavailable, returning computed totals for each combo.

methods.name: getComboById(id)
methods.description: Fetches a combo by ID from backend or mock data if backend is unavailable, returning computed totals.
